comparison_limits: Baseline has one observation per question; final has three requests per question.
Complete explanation uses aligned but different wording; the six other questions have identical wording.
History and provider load differ; this is not a controlled latency benchmark.
Usage is reported for completed model responses; failed calls without usage are not zero-cost evidence.
remaining: Bounded explicit Chinese/English requirements, not general semantic understanding.
Gateway failures and latency remain provider constraints; no automatic repeated retry or Hadoop resubmission.
Primary service, teammate reproduction and presentation rehearsal were not verified here.
Brief requests still needed one bounded correction; sample requests sometimes reread evidence or add an unnecessary unsupported notice.
